parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols ldp interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: 配置LDP协议在指定接口上启用。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ip.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ipv4 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ip.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ipv4 address 10.2.1.2/29
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family ip.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 3.3.3.3/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces tunnel00 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet unnumbered interface [parameter3]
set interfaces tunnel00 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces tunnel00 unit 0 family inet unnumbered interface lo0.0
set interfaces tunnel00 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置隧道接口使用环回接口的IP地址。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

parameters.name: unnumbered-interface
parameters.explanation: 指定用于未编号地址的接口，例如lo0.0。

set routing-options instance default tra.command: set routing-options instance default traffic-eng tunnels tun-tunnel10
set routing-options instance default tra.explanation: 配置默认实例下的流量工程隧道。

set routing-options instances default tr.command: set routing-options instances default traffic-eng peer 1.1.1.1
set routing-options instances default tr.explanation: 配置默认实例下的流量工程对等体。

set forwarding-options label-switched-in.template: set forwarding-options label-switched-interfaces [parameter1] in-label [parameter2] out-label [parameter3] next-hop [parameter4] interface [parameter5]
set forwarding-options label-switched-in.command: set forwarding-options label-switched-interfaces tun-tunnel10 in-label 30 out-label 120 next-hop 10.2.1.1 interface ge-0/0/0.0
set forwarding-options label-switched-in.explanation: 配置标签交换接口的入标签、出标签、下一跳和接口。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 标签交换接口名称，例如tun-tunnel10。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 下一跳的接口名称，例如ge-0/0/0.0。
